title: Cambridge-sourced Related Glossary expansion — contextual business and workplace terms
editorialStatus: Cambridge Dictionary entries inspected and definitions paraphrased; Vietnamese glosses curated; relation arrays preserved; independent lexical/pedagogical review remains pending
sourcePolicy: Each new glossary row links to a Cambridge Dictionary entry for the added term. Definitions are paraphrased for the sense relevant to the existing source relation. Relation arrays and canonical headwords are not rewritten. A dictionary lookup supports the meaning of a term but does not constitute independent approval of the underlying synonym relationship.
